activities.name: National Museum of Singapore
activities.description: Singapore's oldest museum seeks to inspire with artifacts relating to the nation's history and culture through immersive exhibitions.

activities.name: Peranakan Museum

activities.description: Cultural center and museum celebrating the history, culture, and heritage of Indian Singaporeans.
